title.narrative: Support to Seismic Vulnerability Assessment of Piority Hospitals in Nepal

description.narrative: This activity Support to Seismic Vulnerability Assessment of Piority Hospitals in Nepal is a component of UK Support to Increase Resilience to Natural Disasters in Nepal reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £2,168,822. It works in the following sector(s): Disaster prevention and preparedness, Environmental policy and administrative management, Material relief assistance and services.
